home.heroText: Menya umuco w’u Rwanda, uburanga bwaho n’ibyiza byibukwa. Tangira urugendo rwawe n’amafoto akurura.

about.headline: Menya u Rwanda, igihugu cy'imisozi igihumbi
about.paragraph1: U Rwanda ni igihugu gitangaje cyuzuyemo imisozi ibisi, ibiyaga byaka n'umuco w'impuhwe.
about.paragraph2: Menya ibyiza by'u Rwanda binyuze mu mijyi nka Kigali, ibihugura by'icyayi n'ahantu h'amahoro.
about.paragraph3: Muri YVAN, twizihiza ubwiza bw'u Rwanda kandi tukwiyamira gusura kamere n'umuco byacyo.
about.feature1Text: Imisozi ibisi, imisozi miremire n'ibiyaga bituje ni byo bihariye u Rwanda.
about.feature2Text: Abaturage b'ineza n'umutima w'akanyamuneza bituma gusura Rwanda biba iby'iteka.

destination.headline: Menya u Rwanda, igihugu cy'imisozi igihumbi
destination.paragraph1: U Rwanda ni igihugu gitangaje cy'imisozi ibisi, ibiyaga byaka n'umuco w'impuhwe.
destination.paragraph2: Uhereye muri Volcanoes National Park kugana ku kiyaga cya Kivu, buri hantu hatanga uburanga n'umuco.
destination.paragraph3: Sura imijyi, pariki na za villages zituje kugira wumve neza u Rwanda.
destination.card1Text: Imisozi ibisi, imigezi y'umuyaga n'ibiyaga bituje bigaragaza u Rwanda.
destination.card2Text: Abaturage b'ineza n'umuco bituma gusura u Rwanda biboneka nk'ibidasanzwe.
